# PowerPlay v1.0.0 — Fire TV

*Plex-focused Fire TV app · Fire OS 7/8 · ARMv7*

## Changes in this release

- Initial standalone PowerPlay release based on the optimized Plezy 2.25.0 codebase.
- Rebranded the Fire TV app with purple PowerPlay artwork, launcher assets, splash screen, and banner.
- Introduced the independent Android package `com.power.powerplay` and `powerplay://` links so PowerPlay and Plezy can coexist.
- Retained a Plex-focused movies/TV experience and optimized ExoPlayer/Media3 playback without an MPV runtime.
